form.message:
Project Fulcrum — guided confirmation of the new DEV VNet. The 63 recorded inputs are reused; SKUs, create-new origin and capped usage are already settled. **Assumed Corp policies—not tenant-verified; DEV Architecture-only.**

Proposed isolated Sweden Central VNet: **10.42.0.0/22** (RFC1918). No peering, project VPN/P2S or public VM NIC. This proposal is internally non-overlapping; overlap with eventual tenant networks is not verified.

| Purpose | SKU-derived size | Address prefix | Delegation | NSG-attached | Route table |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Bastion; AzureBastionSubnet | /24; minimum /26 | 10.42.0.0/24 | none | yes | none |
| B1 outbound integration | /26 | 10.42.1.0/26 | Microsoft.Web/serverFarms | yes | none |
| App/Cosmos/Blob/ACR private endpoints; temporary restore PE | /27 | 10.42.1.64/27 | none | yes | none |
| Private D2as_v5 client/runner | /27 | 10.42.1.96/27 | none | yes | none |

Reserve **10.42.1.128/27** unused for growth; it is not a fifth deployed subnet. NAT attaches only to the runner subnet, with no dedicated NAT subnet. Bastion/runner/NAT/disk/two service-owned IPs remain the adopted 80-hour provisioned lifecycle; future authorized removal is required, not deallocation-as-free. The 730-hour app uses independent platform egress for approved identity/monitoring and VNet routing for private image/data; it does not depend on session NAT. Dedicated integration and PE subnets remain separate. NSGs must include Bastion-required control rules, Bastion-to-runner SSH and intended HTTPS data paths; no Internet management rule. PE network policies are Disabled in the proposed canonical row, so do not claim its attached subnet NSG filters PE traffic.

Central service-correct DNS zones/records/VNet links must be verified by Governance/platform owners before planning completion; the adopted four-zone cost allocation is not ownership, actual billing or duplicate-zone deployment approval. All runtime paths remain Unverified. Confirm the entire displayed CIDR/subnet plan, or revise it using this same field. A changed CIDR requires a revalidated, contained subnet plan. This is not Gate 2, spend, tenant verification, Azure read/write/deletion or deployment approval.

vnet_plan_decision.title: Confirm or revise the proposed DEV VNet CIDR and four-subnet plan
vnet_plan_decision.description: Confirm binds 10.42.0.0/22 and all four displayed canonical rows, their NSG/route/delegation settings, runner-only NAT association and unused growth reservation as the DEV planning proposal. Choose Revise, or enter custom replacement CIDR/row values here; only genuinely unresolved edits will trigger a follow-up. No approval is preselected and no tenant compatibility or resource-operation permission is implied.
enum: Confirm proposed CIDR and subnet plan

answers.dev_access_restore_dns_meter_profile: Adopt the proposed capped access/restore and DNS allocation scenario
answers.sku_storage_repl: LRS — explicit locally redundant replication pin
